newsitem.title: INDIA: India clears SBI GDR proposal - paper.
newsitem.headline: India clears SBI GDR proposal - paper.

text.p: An Indian newspaper said on Friday that Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's cabinet has given final approval to the State Bank of India (SBI) to issue up to $500 million in global depositary receipts (GDRs).
The Economic Times said the Cabinet Committee on Foreign Investment cleared the proposal on Thursday. A government spokesman said the cabinet's decisions were expected to be announced on Friday.
The business newspaper said the cabinet committee also approved foreign investment proposals put forward by Hughes Ispat, Reliance Telecom and Jindal Power.

The proposal by Hughes Ispat, a joint telecommunications venture between India's Ispat group and Hughes of the United States, involved increasing the foreign equity stake in the venture to 49 percent from 40 percent, it said.
